style.vernacular: Compact papal city-state of Renaissance and Baroque stone: pale travertine and limestone for St Peter's, the colonnade and Museums facades; warm ochre, pink-ochre and cream rendered palazzi with white stone window frames for the Apostolic Palace, Governorate and service buildings; Fascist-era (1929-1940) travertine and marble civic blocks. Hipped terracotta-tile roofs, grey lead domes, sampietrini and travertine paving, clipped hedges, stone pines and cedars in the gardens, all inside high ochre defensive walls.
style.ornament: Giant Corinthian orders and pilasters, travertine balustrades with saint statues, pedimented window aedicules, stucco relief on garden villas, obelisks and fountains, papal and Swiss-guard heraldry (render as blank shields), clipped box parterres.
